args.content: {"success_rate": 1.0, "episodes_run": 20, "notes": "Right-hand (left if bag y>0) punch with feet planted and CoM feedback; 20/20 seeds on the practice bag swung it 34-39 cm without falling (max tilt ~4 deg). Bags farther than ~0.45 m in x or near y=0 are less reliable (some miss the 0.2 m swing)."}

text:
The controller in `controller.py` succeeded in all 20 final runs on the practice setup (bag at 0.38, -0.15, 1; seeds 0–19). Each run struck the bag with the right hand, swung it 34–39 cm (the requirement is 0.2 m), and never fell. Maximum torso tilt was about 4°.

The controller keeps both feet planted and uses `WholeBody.solve` with `ComFeedback` to hold balance. It brings the fist to a wind-up point 17 cm in front of the bag, punches through the bag's centre in 0.15 s, then pulls the arm back. The centre of mass leans a little forward as the arm extends. The left hand is used when the bag hangs at y > 0.

I also tried other bag positions, each with a single seed (seed 1). Bags near the practice position worked, including ones on the left side and at y = 0 with x ≤ 0.4. Bags that are farther out, around x ≥ 0.45, or that hang low, are less reliable, and some miss the 0.2 m swing. Pushing the forward lean harder fixed some of those but made the practice case fall. I settled on a lean that grows with the bag's x distance.

`report.json` is written with success rate 1.0 over 20 episodes. That rate covers the practice setup only. The motion files from the 20 final runs are in `live/` as `final_s0.motion.json` to `final_s19.motion.json`.
